attributes.action: Stop UKYP being scraped and given no grant
attributes.additional_details: Uk youth parliament is being scrapped as they don’t want to fund it this is so important and affects our generation sooo much
attributes.background: Give the uk youth parliament back their grant so young people’s voices can continue to be heard especially with voting age going down to 16. They should respect us as what happens in parliament affects us the most. We want a say we want a grant we want a future that is fair.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this, which you may wish to sign:

Fund the UK Youth Parliament beyond 2027
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/780584
